═══ Update Command ═══

Manage @claude-flow package updates with auto-update support.

Subcommands:
  - check       - Check for available updates
  - all         - Update all packages
  - history     - View update history
  - rollback    - Rollback last update
  - clear-cache - Clear update check cache

Environment Variables:
  - CLAUDE_FLOW_AUTO_UPDATE=false  - Disable auto-update
  - CLAUDE_FLOW_FORCE_UPDATE=true - Force update check

Run "claude-flow update <subcommand> --help" for subcommand help
